placements.why: This envelope's entire content is a database technology decision (Zypherion adoption, its performance rationale, and migration schedule) — no existing strata category exists to hold architecture/infrastructure decisions, and this content is squarely organizational-category grain, not leaf grain. Minting the top-level Architecture category gives future database, pipeline, and infrastructure envelopes a home.
placements.title: Technical infrastructure choices form their own organizational category
placements.frame: Does this expression concern a technology, system, or infrastructure decision that shapes how the organization builds and runs its platform?

placements.title: Technology choices settle into binding commitments with scheduled execution
placements.frame: Does this expression ratify a specific technology adoption and its timeline as already decided, rather than propose or debate it?
placements.why: Quinton's spoken 'We are adopting Zypherion' and 'The migration starts next quarter' perform the adoption and its schedule as settled fact, not open proposals, and Xena's digest echoes ('Database: Zypherion for analytics', 'Timeline: Migration starts Q3 2026') record the same two commitments in condensed form. This is a recurring subject — technology adoption decisions with committed timelines — that future envelopes will keep feeding as the organization makes more architecture calls, not a one-time fact; no existing leaf covers it since the graph is currently empty.

Both 'It handles columnar queries 15x faster than our current setup' and its digest echo 'Performance: 15x improvement on columnar queries' state a quantified comparative claim used to justify the Zypherion decision, but as evidence rather than ratification — a distinct recurring theme (performance justification for architecture choices) that will keep recurring across future technology decisions, separate from the adoption-commitment theme itself even though the two are tightly related in this envelope.
placements.title: Quantified benchmarks stand as evidence marshalled for architecture choices
placements.frame: What quantified performance claim is being offered to justify a technology decision, and does it carry the settled weight of the decision itself or remain an arguable claim?
